about_the_game:
Robes & Wrinkles is a first-person power-fantasy game placing you in the "Robes" of an evil sorcerer. Taking place within a comically oversized tower, you will face strange warped foes who will be made to cower at your power!

Physics-Based Tomfoolery

The non-serious gameplay allows players to truly immerse themselves as the "Evil Supreme Overlord" they should aspire to be. Smite weaklings with books, tables, barrels (and the literal kitchen sink) to remove the fools from your path...

Procedural Dungeons And Handcrafted Story Levels

Play through a mixture of handcrafted and randomised dungeons! Learn new spells and abilities before facing the Rubixium, your own "Room-Shuffler", in either an endless mode or through the story.

A Cheeky Companion

You are not alone... Form a pact with your once former minion (...and now "left-hand man") 'Skully' and use them to channel your powers! Possess objects, cast spells and unleash your ultimate "evilness" against those who oppose your power!

What To Expect

Being an Early Access game at launch and considering the gameplay, Robes & Wrinkles is a game about chaotic moments and so may feature the occasional bug. Our aim is to provide you with something at launch that can be continuously replayed and we want your feedback to influence our future decisions! 

We design and develop for fun, if you find something buggy but non game-breaking and funny then make sure to screenshot and show it off! Things will always get fixed and we our keen to share our roadmap soon.

short_description: You have been betrayed... Climb your tower, reclaim your throne and show that good-for-nothing apprentice whose boss in this first-person, physics-based power-fantasy game! Let none escape your wrath, even the rats...
